simple.meaning: חֲנַן (chănan) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to favor or (causatively) to entreat.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 2 times across Daniel, beginning at Daniel 4:24. Its contexts include kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חֲנַן (H2604).

firstOccurrence.englishText: “This is the interpretation, O king, and it is the decree of the Most High, which has come on my lord the king:

timeline.evidenceText: “This is the interpretation, O king, and it is the decree of the Most High, which has come on my lord the king:

Then they came near, and spoke before the king concerning the king’s decree: “Haven’t you signed a decree that every man who makes a petition to any god or man within thirty days, except to you, O king, shall be cast into the den of lions?”
